content: 请把 sales.csv 做成10页英文销售复盘演示网页 sales-en.html，包含按月、区域和产品的收入及毛利图表，并给出三条行动建议。请先用 spawn_agent 创建一个后台 Coder 子代理（run_in_background=true），让它独立读表、分析数据、用 Write 写自包含网页并读回检查，不用 delegate_task 工作卡。子代理请用 Read 读取CSV，不使用 Bash 或系统命令。你在它运行期间整理汇报提纲，完成后告诉我结果。派发子代理时只调用工具，不要附带任何正文或前言。

arguments.task:
Create a 10-page English sales review presentation webpage at `sales-en.html` (relative to the current working directory: /workspace) from the data in `sales.csv`.

STRICT TOOL CONSTRAINTS:
- Read the CSV with the `Read` tool ONLY. Do NOT use Bash, shell commands, python, pandas, or any system CLI at any point. Locate the file with `Glob` or `ListDirectory` if the path is unclear.
- Write the webpage with the `Write` tool (use `Append` for later chunks if the content is long; set final chunk appropriately).
- After writing, READ THE FILE BACK with the `Read` tool to verify it exists, is non-trivial in size, has no placeholder/TODO text left, and all 10 slides are present. Report the verification evidence.

DATA STEP:
1. Read `sales.csv` fully. Confirm the real column names, date column, numeric columns, and row count from the actual file — never invent column names.
2. Aggregate by month, by region, and by product: revenue and gross profit (and gross margin % where useful). Do the arithmetic carefully by hand/inline in the page data block, and make sure totals reconcile (sum of monthly revenue ≈ total revenue; same for region and product).
3. If the CSV has missing/blank values, handle them explicitly and note the count in the deck.

DELIVERABLE — `sales-en.html`:
- ONE fully self-contained HTML file: all CSS inside a `<style>` tag, all JS inside a `<script>` tag. No external CDN, no npm, no build step, no separate .css/.js files. It must render correctly by just opening the file in a browser. Charts must be hand-built with inline SVG or CSS (bars/lines/donut), not a charting library.
- English throughout. Exactly 10 slides/pages, in a deliberate narrative order, e.g.: (1) Title + period + headline numbers, (2) Executive summary, (3) Method & data notes, (4) Monthly revenue trend, (5) Monthly gross profit & margin trend, (6) Revenue by region, (7) Gross profit / margin by region, (8) Revenue by product, (9) Product margin ranking (best vs worst), (10) Three action recommendations.
- Slide navigation: prev/next buttons, keyboard arrow keys (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight, and Space), a slide counter (e.g. "4 / 10"), and clickable dot/number indicators. Slides should be a proper presentation surface (one slide visible at a time, full-viewport, responsive down to a 390px mobile width without horizontal overflow).
- Every chart needs readable axis labels, value labels or tooltips, a legend where needed, and a short one-line "so what" insight caption beneath it.
- Include real KPI cards with actual computed numbers from the data (total revenue, total gross profit, blended margin %, best month, best region, best product).
- The three action recommendations must be specific and data-grounded (name the region/product/month and the number behind the call), each with an owner-style action, an expected impact, and a way to measure it.
- Design it deliberately: modern typographic scale, a coherent palette with a clear accent color, generous spacing, subtle motion on slide change. Do not ship unstyled browser defaults. Light or dark is your call, but it must look intentional and presentation-ready.

Then read the file back and confirm all of the above before finishing.
